title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) expected to play on Sunday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) is expected to play on Sunday against the Saints barring a surprise setback.
items.impact: Bowers has been out for the first two weeks of the season after undergoing a meniscus trim surgery, but it looks like he will be back for Sunday. Start him in all formats, but temper expectations as he could start off a little slow.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) expected to play against Cincy
items.desc: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) is expected to play on Sunday against the Bengals after being listed with a shoulder injury this week. He was able to get some limited practice sessions in later in the week, and is likely good to go.
items.impact: Fellow RB Rico Dowdle is out for the game, so Warren's availability is crucial for the team that lacks an experienced back behind him. He should be an RB2 with upside thanks to his pass catching skillset.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) expected to play on Sunday against Cincy
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is expected to play on Sunday against the Bengals after being considered questionable with a foot injury.
items.impact: Pittman should give Aaron Rodgers a reliable possession receiver over the middle of the field, opening things up for the offense. Germie Bernard tried to play that role last week, but didn't quite have the same fluidity as Pittman. He should be a decent WR3 with upside.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Laken Tomlinson signs with Packers
items.desc: The Packers signed G Laken Tomlinson.
items.impact: Tomlinson will add depth to a banged up Packers offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: P.J. Locke (foot) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cowboys placed S P.J. Locke on injured reserve.
items.impact: Locke will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Caleb Williams has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Williams was never expected to play this week after going down with his injury last week. It will be Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum starting on Monday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Broncos placed RB Jonah Coleman on injured reserve.
items.impact: Coleman had already been ruled out for this week's game. He will now miss at least the next four games. J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey will continue to lead the Broncos backfield.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) cleared for Week 3
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is off of the injury report and cleared to play for the Philadelphia Eagles against the Chicago Bears Monday night.
items.impact: Smith is good to go for head coach Nick Sirianni after logging practice sessions on back-to-back days to end the week while battling a lingering hamstring injury, offering quarterback Jalen Hurts is primary pass-catching target against a shaky Bears secondary Monday night.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Saquon Barkley (stinger) off injury report for Eagles
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (stinger) is off of the injury report and cleared to play for the Philadelphia Eagles against the Chicago Bears Monday night according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Barkley is good to go after logging full practice sessions to end the week for head coach Nick Sirianni, boosting a Philadelphia rushing attack that will look to take advantage of a susceptible Bears defense Monday night.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyson Bagent (concussion) cleared to practice Saturday
items.desc: Bears head coach Ben Johnson told reporters QB Tyson Bagent will practice Saturday.
items.impact: Bagent has not officially cleared protocol, but he has cleared the necessary steps to practice. He still has a chance to play on Monday against the Eagles.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Wright (stinger/foot) doubtful to play Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (stinger/foot) is doubtful to play in Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: The Dolphins are expected to be without Wright this weekend, as he was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Friday. His expected absence won't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes, however, as he has only seen three carries over the course of the season thus far.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ryan Miller (hip/back) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Ryan Miller (hip/back) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Kanas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Miller is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's dealing with a pair of injuries right now and is likely considered day-to-day as a result. If he's cleared to play, he will see more work than usual with Caleb Douglas (ankle) set to be sidelined against the Chiefs.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: The rookie will be available to play on Sunday after being limited at practice earlier in the week due to a knee issue of some kind. Expect him to see even more work with Caleb Douglas (ankle) set to be sidelined against the Chiefs this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chop Robinson (concussion) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Chop Robinson (concussion) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Robinson is set to play on Sunday after recently clearing the NFL's concussion protocols. His return will offer a nice boost to Miami's defense this week, though it still projects to struggle against Kansas City's offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashee Rice (knee) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Rashee Rice (knee) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Rice's knee injury is nothing more than a minor issue at this point and won't affect his availability for Week 3. Fantasy managers should be starting him this week, though maybe expectations should be tempered for him after an underwhelming first two games of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) will play Sunday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) will play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: The rookie will be available to play on Sunday, despite dealing with a shoulder injury throughout the week at practice. Kansas City's defense projects to be a great fantasy option this week in an easy matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: The veteran was limited at practice all week due to a knee injury, but he has been cleared to play and should be good to go against the Dolphins this week. He will continue to play an important role on Kansas City's stellar defense for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Josh Simmons (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Simmons is set to miss yet another game on Sunday due to his nagging back injury. Rookie Kahlil Benson will likely continue to start in the place of the absent veteran for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe) won't play in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The veteran is going to be sidelined in Week 3. He's dealing with a toe injury of some kind right now, and it's unclear whether or not it will cause him to miss more time beyond this game. Baltimore's offense may struggle a bit more without their starting left tackle in a matchup against the Cowboys this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) available to play Sunday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) is available to play in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Simpson is going to play this week, which seemed to be the expectation from the start. Baltimore's offensive line will still be at less than full strength, however, with Ronnie Stanley Jr. (toe) set to be sidelined against the Cowboys.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) active for Sunday
items.desc: Chris Moore (ankle) will be active for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The Ravens have upgraded Moore to available to play for Sunday's game against the Cowboys. He won't be a relevant fantasy option either way but may see more work than usual if Zay Flowers (hamstring) is out for that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) set to make season debut Sunday
items.desc: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) is set to make his season debut in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The Ravens have been without Madubuike all season so far due to a neck injury that he's been recovering from, but he seems to be back at full health and has no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game. He should be a full go against the Cowboys, and his presence will be a significant boost to Baltimore's defensive front moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Baltimore's star edge rusher will be available to play on Sunday, despite being on the injury report all week due to a lingering finger issue. The team will need him to step up in a tough matchup against Dallas' high-powered offense this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Flowers was sidelined due to a hamstring injury last week, but he may be able to make his return on Sunday, as he is currently listed as questionable to play. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health leading up to game time to see whether or not he will have a big snap count if he's active at all this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Teddye Buchanan (knee) active for Sunday
items.desc: Teddye Buchanan (knee) will be active for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Buchanan is going to play on Sunday. This is good news for Baltimore's defense, which projects to improve now that they are getting several key players back from injury this week.
